latest_release.body:
# Version 4.0.1 (November 11, 2026)

## Compiler

1. [`21a076966`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/21a076966) Added [`mjs_getInStringVec`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mjs_getInStringVec) to read entries from an [mjStringVec](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/APItypes.html#mjStringVec) by index.

## Python bindings

2. [`a937a4f91`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/a937a4f91) Enabled the MuJoCo Studio Web Viewer (`mujoco-studio --gfx=web` and
   `mujoco.studio.launch_web`) on Windows by shipping the precompiled browser client in a platform-independent
   `mujoco-studio-wasm` wheel installed automatically by `mujoco-studio`.

## Bug fixes

3. [`9ae9bad01`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/9ae9bad01) Fixed a bug in the sparse Cholesky factorization introduced in 4.0.0, which merged rows with
   different descendants into one supernode and gave the Newton solver a wrong Hessian factor when the constraint
   Jacobian is sparse, causing slow convergence, wrong accelerations and divergence ([#3767](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues/3767)).

4. [`144ede984`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/144ede984) [`mj_loadAllPluginLibraries`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mj_loadAllPluginLibraries) now skips a dynamic library that fails to load with a warning
   instead of calling [`mju_error`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mju_error), so one unloadable library in the plugin directory no longer aborts
   [simulate](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/samples.html#saSimulate) at startup. In the 4.0.0 macOS and Linux archives this happened with the USD decoder
   plugin, which can only be loaded from a Python process.

5. [`409f981ab`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/409f981ab) Fixed issues in single-shot [multicontact](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/computation/index.html#coMultiCCD) for cylinder edge collisions
   ([#3748](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues/3748), [#3752](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues/3752)).
